provenance.descriptorKind: Derived v0.19.1 declaration compatibility descriptors; not original execution manifests.
limitations: Original campaign/stage manifests, archived INI files, owned runtime snapshots and native-preflight proofs were not supplied. Derived descriptors verify declaration compatibility, not original runtime provenance.
Opening observations report an executable hash and Fairy-Stockfish 230826; this audit has not inspected that executable or attested its native piece-value tables.

All forced prefixes and their stored opening FENs are replayed with the frozen browser rules. Only the eight recorded mate-in-one continuations are independently replayed to a terminal result; other full game moves and outcomes are not replayed.
The thirty-two related fixed opening cases, chosen search priors and forced-prefix protocol limit generalization. Conditional opening-block ranges exclude engine and protocol bias.
The two-opening omission is a labeled sensitivity analysis across both colors and all reference cells. It neither replaces official scores nor selects a revised matchup-specific opening book.
No scored matches, engine searches, new material-value fits, individual-piece Elo or automatic playable promotions were produced.

sources.policy: Preserve each accepted body's tested applied MG/EG prior or exact matched family anchor, applying it to all six engine tables for both colors. These are engine search settings, not material estimates or upgrade purchase points.

evaluationAudit.policy: Freeze shared family priors for each trial bracket: L1 queens 2771/2833, L2 pawns 536/592, L3 knight pawns 762/808 from Ranger. Herald control keeps 418/436; QgsQ0 Wraith keeps 3772/3470 from its historical Wraith anchor. Fixed references retain their tested values. All six engine tables and both colors are verified. Search priors are not measured material values or purchase prices.

report.openingPolicy: One shared eight-family book for all tiers, armies and colors. Each eight-case batch has one case from each structural family. All 64 ordinary positions are distinct after ignoring move clocks. Prefixes contain eight standard plies, preserve material and stop outside check; they are not chosen for near-zero upgraded-army evaluations. The complete book must pass ordinary-chess replay and actual-army legality before collection. Static tactical flags remain diagnostic and never silently remove cells. Related prefixes are not independent population samples.

openingWarnings.ordinaryOpponent: With only White queen upgraded in the ordinary starting army, Qh5+ forces g6. Exhaustive three-ply testing finds no forced mate within two; Qe5 after that reply is not check because vertical hopping is absent. Both physical colors are checked.
openingWarnings.searchLimit: Bounded engine searches suggest substantial opening pressure under their probe settings. This is not proof of forced material gain, an intrinsic value or a match result.
openingWarnings.forcedBookLimit: The shared eight-ply prefixes prescribe the opening instead of allowing the engine to choose its first move. This trial measures those declared positions and does not measure unrestricted first-move opening power. The warning does not remove or reweight games.
